domain: Structural Dynamics of Constraint Misclassification / Social Epistemology / Power-Indexed Extraction
topic_summary: Analysis of how identical structural constraints are experienced and classified differently based on observer power position, time horizon, and exit options. Examines the dynamics of false mountain classification (treating constructed extraction as natural law), coordination-extraction entanglement, and the structural mechanisms that enable constraint misperception to persist across power gradients.

key_entities: Powerless agent (trapped in biographical time, local scope, no exit)
Social belief system (enforcement mechanism for resource allocation)
key_tensions: Subjective classification vs objective extractiveness (same constraint, different types across indices)
Coordination value vs extraction burden (hybrid constraints experienced as pure by different agents)
Individual heroism vs collective action (routing around vs challenging constructed constraints)

omegas.description: Is the chi formula (ε × π × σ) capturing the right structural dimensions? Alternative formulations might weight exit options or time horizon differently, changing which constraints appear as mountains vs snares from which indices.
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 1 (Operational Medium) - the chi calculation itself is an unexamined structural choice

omegas.description: Are the type thresholds (0.46 for Tangled Rope, 0.70 for Snare) universal or domain-dependent? Different institutional rationality models might require different threshold values for same constraint to manifest as different types.
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 2 (Absence Inventory) - threshold justification not present in formalization

omegas.description: Do moderate-power agents who benefit from coordination-extraction invisibility have structural incentives to maintain false mountain narratives? If so, is this a second-order snare (extraction through epistemic manipulation)?

omegas.description: Are transformation rules (TR1-TR4) reversible? Can organized agents drift back to powerless? Can revealed snares be re-naturalized as mountains? Hysteresis vs full reversibility changes attractor topology.

fracture_scan.notes: F03 detected: power_indexed_classification_variance classified as mountain (invariant mathematical consequence) but this assumes chi formula correctly captures structural reality. If formula is itself a constructed choice rather than natural law, classification should be piton (atrophied alternative formulations). Generated omega_chi_formula_validity to bound this uncertainty. However, within the formalization's own framework, the variance is indeed invariant (given the formula), so mountain classification is internally consistent even if the framework itself is constructed.
